test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on a sum at 3% p.a. in 3 years is ₹315. What is the compound interest on the same sum at 4% p.a. in 2 years, interest compounded yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

SI for 3 years = ₹315

Rate = 3%

**Formula used:**

S.I = PRT/100

C.I = P [(1 + R/100) n - 1]

Where,

S.I = Simple Interest,

P = Principal,

R = Rate, T or n = Time

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

315 = (P × 3 × 3)/100

⇒ P = 3500

Again according to the question,

C.I = 3500 [(1 + 4/100) 2 - 1]

⇒ 3500 [(26/25)2 - 1]

⇒ 3500 [676 - 625/625]

⇒ 3500 [51/625]

⇒ C.I = ₹285.6

**∴ The compound interest is ₹285.6.**
